text: `ValueError` — specifically `ValueError("Malformed timezone string.")`. In `tzres.name_from_string` (dateutil/tz/win.py, lines ~104-111), a string starting with `@` is split on `",-"` and the second field is passed to `int()`; the bare `except:` around that conversion (which also catches the `IndexError` if there is no `",-"` separator) re-raises as `ValueError("Malformed timezone string.")`.

It returns `None`. `tzwinbase.transitions(year)` first checks `if not self.hasdst: return None` (dateutil/tz/win.py, ~line 166); `hasdst` is set from `_get_hasdst()`, which is `self._dstmonth != 0`, so a zone with no DST (no daylight transition month in the registry TZI) yields `None` rather than a `(dston, dstoff)` tuple.

The assert in `main()` (updatezinfo.py line 47) verifies the integrity of the downloaded tzdata archive: it computes the SHA-512 hex digest of the file named by `metadata['tzdata_file']` and asserts it equals the expected digest recorded in the metadata JSON, `metadata['tzdata_file_sha512']` (message "SHA failed for"). So it checks that the downloaded tzdata file matches the expected SHA-512 checksum.

`ValueError` — `easter()` raises `ValueError("invalid method")` for an unrecognized method value (including 0), at the end of the function after the if/elif chain for EASTER_JULIAN/EASTER_ORTHODOX/EASTER_WESTERN.
`EASTER_WESTERN` (i.e. 3) — the signature is `def easter(year, method=EASTER_WESTERN)`, and `EASTER_WESTERN = 3` is defined in the module.

`rebuild(filename, tag=None, format="gz", zonegroups=[], metadata=None)` writes the `metadata` dict into the generated zoneinfo directory as a JSON metadata file: after `zic` compiles the zones, it does `with open(os.path.join(zonedir, METADATA_FN), 'w') as f: json.dump(metadata, f, indent=4, sort_keys=True)` (METADATA_FN = "metadata.json"), so the metadata is packaged into the resulting zoneinfo tarball. If `metadata` is None, `json.dump(None, ...)` writes "null".

It returns `None`. `tzrangebase.utcoffset(dt)` computes `isdst = self._isdst(dt)` and, `if isdst is None: return None`; otherwise it returns `self._dst_offset` when `isdst` is true and `self._std_offset` when it is false (dateutil/tz/_common.py, ~lines 244-252).
It re-raises the last download error: if every mirror fails, `last_error` holds the final `urllib.error.URLError` (set in the `except` block) and `main()` does `raise last_error` after the loop.

It returns `None`: `getzoneinfofile_stream()` catches `IOError`, emits `warnings.warn("I/O error({0}): {1}".format(e.errno, e.strerror))`, and returns `None` (so `ZoneInfoFile(None)` ends up with empty zones and `metadata = None`).

`TypeError("fromutc() requires a datetime argument")` — `_tzinfo._fromutc` starts with `if not isinstance(dt, datetime): raise TypeError(...)` (dateutil/tz/_common.py, ~lines 170-171), before the `dt.tzinfo is not self` check that raises `ValueError`.
